criteria.text: Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Ivybridge Logistics plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $34,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $34,300,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the Upton Media Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($35,000,000 - $350,000 = $34,650,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
